sentences.text: Here is the first key idea.
A category can be seen as a partial algebra.
Take a single set of cells.
Each cell has a source and a target, given by two unary operations.
Objects are identified with their identities, so the source of an arrow is itself a cell.
g composed with f exists exactly when the source of g equals the target of f.
This domain condition is an existence equation.
The category laws become quasi-existence equations, or Q E equations.
